description: Defines classes and functions for managing Git repositories, including merging, cloning, committing, and remote management, utilizing libgit2 library.

classes.name: MergeOptions
classes.description: Structure holding merge configuration options, including branch heads and merge state flags.

classes.name: GitMerge
classes.description: Class providing methods to perform merge operations, resolve references, and handle fast-forward merges.

classes.name: GitManager
classes.description: Class encapsulating Git repository management functions such as clone, init, add remote, commit, push, fetch, merge, pull, and reset.

methods.name: merge_options_init
methods.description: Initializes merge_options structure with default values.

methods.name: resolve_refish
methods.description: Resolves a reference or SHA string to a git_annotated_commit.

methods.name: resolve_heads
methods.description: Resolves multiple branch heads to annotated commits.

methods.name: perform_fastforward
methods.description: Performs a fast-forward merge to a target commit, updating HEAD accordingly.

methods.name: analyze_merge
methods.description: Analyzes merge possibilities and performs merge or fast-forward as appropriate.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Performs a merge operation with default branch 'origin/master'.

methods.name: GitManager
methods.description: Constructor for GitManager class.

methods.name: setUserPass
methods.description: Sets username and password for repository authentication.

methods.name: setSignature
methods.description: Sets user signature with username and email.

methods.name: initLocalRepo
methods.description: Initializes a local repository at specified directory.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Clones a repository from URL to specified path.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens an existing repository at specified directory.

methods.name: addRemote
methods.description: Adds a remote repository.

methods.name: removeRemote
methods.description: Removes a remote repository.

methods.name: renameRemote
methods.description: Renames a remote repository.

methods.name: setUrlRemote
methods.description: Sets URL for a remote repository.

methods.name: getRemoteList
methods.description: Retrieves list of remotes.

methods.name: clearRemoteList
methods.description: Clears the stored remote list.

methods.name: getStatusList
methods.description: Gets current status entries of the repository.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Stages all changes.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a message.

methods.name: commitA
methods.description: Creates a merge commit.

methods.name: commitU
methods.description: Creates an update merge commit.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes commits to remote.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches updates from remote.

methods.name: pull
methods.description: Performs a pull operation.

methods.name: resetHard
methods.description: Resets the repository to HEAD hard.

methods.name: getLogList
methods.description: Retrieves commit log list.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Test method (purpose unspecified).
